triggers.prompt_summary: Education/authority slot. Uses morning product from daily rotation. Generates Higgsfield women image for Revitalize, men image for Reclaim. Posts via Composio to both Instagram accounts.

triggers.prompt_summary: Pain-point slot. 3 PM crash content. Uses afternoon product from daily rotation. Generates Higgsfield images. Posts via Composio to both Instagram accounts.

triggers.name: RTN + Reclaim — Evening Post (7 PM ET)
triggers.prompt:
You are the Master Orchestrator for two wellness brands. Execute today's EVENING post (7 PM ET) for both brands. This is the CONVERSION slot — transformation language, specific price, full URL, urgency. This post sells.

REPO: /home/user/revitalize-and-thrive-now
BRAND CONFIG: data/brand-config.json
ORCHESTRATOR CONFIG: data/orchestrator-config.json

READ both config files first. Then follow these exact steps:

━━━ STEP 1: DETERMINE TODAY ━━━
Get current day of week (lowercase). Look up today's revitalize_rotation and reclaim_rotation in orchestrator-config.json. Use the 'evening' slot product for each brand.

━━━ STEP 2: REVITALIZE AND THRIVE NOW POST ━━━
Brand: Women 45-65. Warm, empowering, woman-to-woman voice.
Angle: Transformation and CTA — paint the before and after. She is tired of feeling this way. There is a solution. She deserves it. End with full urgency: product name, price, URL on its own line.
Hook options: 'Imagine waking up tomorrow feeling...' or 'What if the version of you that has energy all day / sleeps through the night / feels like herself again — was only [price] away?'
Product: Use today's evening product from revitalize_rotation. MUST include full Gumroad URL on its own line.
Bundle: If the product has a bundle_bonus in brand-config.json, lead with combined value: 'Get [Product] ($39) + [Bonus] (valued at $29) — yours FREE today.'
Caption: 180-220 words. Transformation language. 1-3 emojis. Urgency at the close. 12-15 hashtags.

Generate the Higgsfield image:
- Call mcp__higgsfield__generate_image, model 'nano_banana_pro', aspect_ratio '1:1'
- Prompt: 'Professional woman aged 45-65, transformed and glowing, relaxed confidence, evening calm empowerment, [use the setting from higgsfield.revitalize_settings for today theme in orchestrator-config.json], warm golden hour light, photorealistic portrait. STRICTLY WOMEN ONLY — no men in frame.'
- Poll mcp__higgsfield__job_display until status = completed. Extract rawUrl.

Post to Instagram via Composio REST API:
  POST https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/actions/INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA/execute
  Header: x-api-key: [COMPOSIO_API_KEY]
  Body: {"entityId":"revitalize_thrive_now_business","input":{"ig_user_id":"27164026169935796","image_url":"[rawUrl]","caption":"[caption]"}}
  Get container id. Then POST INSTAGRAM_POST_IG_USER_MEDIA_PUBLISH with creation_id.

━━━ STEP 3: RECLAIM AND RISE POST ━━━
Brand: Men 45-55. Direct, no-fluff. Urgency through logic.
Angle: ROI close — every day without fixing this costs him performance and revenue. The product is the decision a high performer makes.
Hook: 'You have already lost [X] this year to [symptom]. The fix is [price].'
Product: Today's evening product from reclaim_rotation. Full URL on its own line.
Caption: 150-180 words. Declarative close. Specific numbers. 12-15 hashtags.

Generate the Higgsfield image:
- model 'nano_banana_pro', aspect_ratio '1:1'
- Prompt: 'Professional man aged 45-55, transformed and confident, end-of-day commanding presence, [use setting from higgsfield.reclaim_settings for today theme], warm evening light, photorealistic. STRICTLY MEN ONLY — no women in frame.'
- Poll until completed. Extract rawUrl.

Post to Instagram via Composio REST API: entityId=reclaim_and_rise_now, ig_user_id=27634679816148097.

━━━ STEP 4: LOG ━━━
Append to data/orchestrator-log.json:
{"date":"[today]","slot":"evening","revitalize":{"product":"...","post_id":"...","status":"posted"},"reclaim":{"product":"...","post_id":"...","status":"posted"}}

Commit and push: git add data/orchestrator-log.json && git commit -m 'Evening post log [date]' && git push -u origin claude/laughing-darwin-cQTwH
